data.body:
CORRECTED: base was stale by one merged change (2c71463b1e, ticket 9bb9),
which taught get_parent_map to also read the Epic Link field and extracted
_resolve_epic_link_field_id as a SHARED lookup between set_parent (write)
and get_parent_map (read). My original relocation would have silently
reverted that fix on cherry-pick since my _hierarchy.py carried the
pre-9bb9 version and no test in my commit's diff would have caught it.

Fixed: git fetch gerrit && git rebase gerrit/main, resolved the transport.py
conflict by taking main's full (post-9bb9) monolith, then redid the
relocation on top of it. _hierarchy.py's _resolve_epic_link_field_id,
get_parent_map, and set_parent now carry the exact post-9bb9 logic
(epic_field discovered once, get_parent_map falls back to the Epic Link
value when fields.parent is absent, fields.parent wins when both present).

Rebased commit: 76fcaa414c (amended in place on top of gerrit/main HEAD
de0deb0c89), still NOT pushed. git merge-base --is-ancestor 2c71463b1e HEAD
confirms 9bb9 is now in history.

Rebased line counts (all under 500, per constraint):
  transport.py  230  (composition root)
  _people.py    177  (identity + properties, co-located)
  _issues.py    170  (TicketTransport CRUD/labels/transitions)
  _base.py      157  (shared substrate)
  _hierarchy.py 154  (grew from 148 -> 154 picking up 9bb9's epic-link
                       read in get_parent_map)
  _links.py     110  (SupportsLinks + SupportsComments, co-located)

Verified the 9bb9 regression did NOT recur: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/
test_dc_inbound_epic_link_9bb9.py - all 7 cells pass on the rebased tree.
Full suites re-run on the rebased base: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler
2125 passed (up from 2098 pre-rebase, reflecting main's newer tests);
tests/integration/rebar_reconciler -m "not external" 36 passed. make lint,
make typecheck (429 files), check_comment_hygiene.py all green.
git show --name-only HEAD still lists only the 7 non-test files - zero
test files edited, confirmed again post-rebase.
